derivedParts.notes: Exact SwitchC6 naked assembly photograph confirms green PCB material. Color is an uncalibrated photo estimate. The photograph is oblique and mostly occluded by capacitors, relay, terminals and a vertical radio daughterboard; it cannot support projecting the full populated assembly onto one flat board. Envelope, hidden layout and depth remain UNKNOWN.

derivedParts.notes: Source side actuator faces +Y near the PCB seam, not the printed BUTTON word. Independent orange material; only this physical cap emits the existing official GPIO7 User control. Local opening is genuinely removed from the approximate wall. No hidden PCB population or mechanical linkage inferred.

Independent drawing gives57.9×46×26.8mm overall and54×32mm housing; product table rounds to58×46×27mm. Terminal cavities/lever depths, transparent shell and DIN details are approximations; no internal relay/AC electrical simulation. Public MAC-sticker detail photographs are not retained.

The official shop republishes a credited SK LABS bare-assembly photograph. It establishes green PCB color and tall/vertical components, but lacks orthographic full-board coverage and per-part heights. UNKNOWN remains; the exterior translucent shell photographs are never used as PCB texture. The existing blank single-board envelope does not reconstruct the pictured power board, relay or radio daughterboard.

The local +Y user-button mouth/cap and front U-notch are estimated exterior corrections from the official orthographic drawing and exact-SKU photographs. Cap envelope about 8x4 mm and Z centre about -5.1 mm were scaled against the 54 mm housing width; +/-0.6 mm local registration, cap depth0.8 mm +/-0.5 mm and opening depth are not measurements or official CAD. Tact mechanism/linkage and populated board remain UNKNOWN. Side access is modeled; the front shell must still occlude the button from +Z.

visibleFaceReview.observedFace: The official gallery views are through translucent plastic. An official-shop article credited to SK LABS contains an uncased oblique assembly showing a green mainboard, tall capacitors/relay and vertical radio daughterboard.
visibleFaceReview.decision: Retain UNKNOWN rather than flattening multiple heights or inventing a complete PCB layout. Update only the source-backed green substrate material, archive the newly located real assembly reference and document missing planar coverage/depths.
visibleFaceReview.unknownPolicy: Existing UNKNOWN annotation remains visible through the translucent front in the production viewer; populated geometry, layered board assembly and hidden areas remain unresolved.
visibleFaceReview.limits: No complete board CAD, calibrated bare-board orthographic front/back pair, or trustworthy component-height drawing found in inspected sources. A failed guessed GitHub product-directory lookup is recorded as unavailable, not evidence that no file can exist.
visibleFaceReview.exteriorButtonCorrection: Official drawing and photo-3 expose a separate orange side actuator and mouth; local derived geometry restores them without inferring the populated board. Source photo-9/button arrow is supporting location evidence, never used as a click region itself.
